summary.text: Clancy Baucom is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat John J. Kirkpatrick IV.
According to his campaign website, he is a Union County commissioner and has operated a wholesale nursery business in Marshville for 37 years.

paragraphs.text: Baucom's campaign website describes him as a native of rural Union County whose family has been rooted there for generations, and as a businessman, farmer and Sunday school teacher.
It says he graduated from Piedmont High School, earned an associate degree from NC State University, and has been married to his wife Kim for 35 years; they have three adult daughters.

The site says that as a commissioner he has provided tax incentives to attract businesses, supported a program to bring a cleaner and larger water supply to residents, and worked to preserve farmland.
It lists his priorities for the General Assembly as religious freedom, election integrity, supporting the life of the unborn, fewer business regulations and protecting Second Amendment rights.
